plugins.name: sprites
plugins.description: Sprites sandboxes for Grok Build via hosted MCP (OAuth). Create isolated compute, run commands and tests, manage services and checkpoints. Install with: grok plugin install superfly/sprites-grok-plugin --trust. First prompt after install: List my sprites. Then try /sprites-status or /sprites-smoke.
